qualified: Both cancellation and timeout at every observed TIFF/JXL checked/native seam, including opening, inspection and publication.
Coincident native-open failure or traced application failure retains its original cause and also exposes the observed stop.
Later calls on a stopped operation retain the reason and do not re-enter native code or the stop callback.
Ordinary source faults and missing-factory refusals report no observed stop.
limits: None classifies only the shared token observation, not every possible backend-specific cancellation.
No hard bound on latency within native or transport calls.
Test/build resource receipts are not native codec workspace bounds or performance comparisons.
